name: copy-button-buttons
title: Copy Button: Buttons
description:
Use existing button sizes and surfaces, or compose a labeled button.

The labeled button keeps all labels mounted in one grid cell. Its width accommodates the longest label, while opacity and a small vertical transition change the visible state. Reduced motion disables the transition.
